info.name: Web grading service - verbose evidence
info.description: Hardest-case requests + live evidence responses for the grading-logs program (phases A1-A4, max-policy, scope). Host vars point direct-to-service (no auth on /internal/**; X-Gateway-Secret+X-User-Id elsewhere) or at the gateway (Bearer JWT). Fill collection variables once, run top-down. Captured 2026-10-12 against course/submission/result booted on docker PG16 with forged identity — zero production contact. Requests marked NO_SAVED need live data/JWT/storage; their defs are complete, bodies never fabricated.

variable.description: Lecturer or student JWT for gateway calls

item.name: Admin user import (gateway)

request.description: ADMIN role required (403 otherwise). Set form-data file src to samples/users-import-hard.csv (uppercase username, blank fullName, blank role=STUDENT, lecturer row, duplicate username, unknown role, short row). Initial password = lowercased username, forced change first login. NO saved response: never executed against live (would mint real users) — run on staging with a temp file, delete probe users via Keycloak admin API, paste the real 200 + a 4xx case here.
